hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-003-M2 · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise reduced roll authority from control feel and the degraded-law annunciation and to maintain wings-level and track with increased lateral input.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-003-PL · framed per HIDH §5.7 cognitive workload

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the erroneous pitch response from aircraft motion against command and the degraded-law annunciation, identify it as an erroneous response, and counter it with pitch inceptor input.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-004-M · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise the uncommanded pitch motion from aircraft response, identify it as uncommanded, and arrest it with pitch inceptor input.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-004-M2 · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise degraded pitch response from control feel and the degraded-law annunciation and to fly and configure the aircraft with increased pitch input.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-004-PL · framed per HIDH §5.7 cognitive workload

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the erroneous yaw response from aircraft motion against command, identify it as an erroneous response, and counter it with pedal input to stabilise the flight path.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-005-M · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise the uncommanded yaw motion from aircraft response, identify it as uncommanded, and counter it with pedal input.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-005-M2 · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise reduced directional authority from the degraded-control annunciation and control feel and to maintain directional control with increased pedal input, particularly in the asymmetric-thrust case.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-005-PL · framed per HIDH §5.7 cognitive workload

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the unexpected high-lift movement from configuration indication and handling change, identify the discrepant configuration, and manage speed to the resulting configuration.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-006-M · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the discrepancy from configuration/position indication and alerting, revert to a known configuration, and manage speed.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-006-M2 · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the asymmetry from the asymmetry/position discretes, apply lateral control, select an appropriate configuration and revised speeds, and manage a longer field requirement.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-006-PL · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the reduced configuration from position indication, revise speeds and field performance, and manage the degraded schedule.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-006-PL2 · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the failure from configuration/position indication and alerting and apply the flapless/degraded-configuration procedure with revised speeds and field performance.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-006-TL · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise the degraded gear condition and apply directional-control corrections during rollout on the unprepared surface.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-007-PL · framed per HIDH §5.7 cognitive workload

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to detect the uncommanded yaw from heading and yaw cues and counter it with steering, differential-brake and rudder inputs during the ground roll.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-008-M · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to perceive the yaw/heading cue and counter it with steering, differential braking and rudder input.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-009-M · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to observe that the aircraft is not tracking as commanded and revert to differential braking and rudder to hold centreline.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-009-M2 · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise the loss of directional control from heading and yaw cues and maintain directional control by differential braking and rudder pedal input.
hfaRows.origin: AI · HFA draft from SF-009-PL · framed per HIDH §5.7.4.2.2 multiple-resource task decomposition

hfaRows.text: The crew is assumed to recognise the loss of directional control from heading deviation and steering cues and to hold centreline by differential braking.
